connector.name: OPA MCP
connector.registryDescription: Author, validate, debug, and explain OPA Rego policies through any MCP-compatible client.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package opa-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the orygnscode account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OPA_URL
env.description: Base URL of a running OPA server. Required only for opa_* runtime tools, not for rego_* language tools.

env.name: OPA_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token for OPA running with --authentication=token.

env.name: OPA_BINARY
env.description: Path to the opa binary. Defaults to 'opa' on PATH.

env.name: REGAL_BINARY
env.description: Path to the regal binary (optional, used by rego_lint). Defaults to 'regal' on PATH.

env.name: CONFTEST_BINARY
env.description: Path to the conftest binary (optional, used by conftest_* tools). Defaults to 'conftest' on PATH.

env.name: OPA_MCP_ALLOWED_PATHS
env.description: Comma-separated list of root directories tools may read/write. When unset, file-based tools refuse to access the disk.

env.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
env.description: GitHub personal access token with the "gist" scope. Required only for rego_playground_share.
